artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan: re-measure the IsRegular binder population and land a re-runnable C34 census, document the `Constraints consumed:` docstring normal form, restate the eight independence-claiming declarations at explicit hypotheses with unchanged-signature corollaries, then gate C34 soft-then-enforced and document it.

memory_candidates.content: An opt-in at-site marker convention (a docstring/annotation line a declaration carries voluntarily) is silently bypassable: new code that should carry the marker simply omits it and the gate sees nothing. The fix is to pair the structural assertion with a TRIGGER assertion over the same population: a deliberately loose prose/shape heuristic that fires on candidates and demands only that a marker be present, never rendering a verdict on the marker's content. False positives then cost one marker line each instead of a redesign, and the marker stops being opt-in. Land the trigger half reporting-only first (soft-then-enforced), read the hit list, add the demanded markers, then flip enforcement. Pair with an anti-silence guard treating a zero-marker or empty-walk result as a broken matcher rather than a clean tree, and prefer at-site markers over a central manifest since central reason files go stale silently when the code they cover moves.
